versions.content: The LIN Interface shall call the function PduR_LinTpStartOfReception with a PduInfo pointer and TpSduLength when the start of a TP message reception is indicated by the reception of a FF or a SF. PduInfo is pointer to the buffer containing the received data (SduDataPtr) and data length (SduLength). The data length (including SID) is 5 bytes for FF and up to 6 bytes for SF. TpSduLength is the total length of the Sdu.
